model_annotation: The line graph illustrates the number of issued permits for the construction of new residential buildings in Bulgaria from 2012 to 2022, categorized by the type of permit: administrative, other, and building. The horizontal x-axis represents the years from 2012 to 2022, while the vertical y-axis indicates the number of permits. The data shows that the number of administrative permits (blue line) remained relatively stable, fluctuating between 70 and 187 over the decade. The number of other permits (orange line) showed a general decline from 4,938 in 2012 to a low of 3,944 in 2020, before rising again to 4,631 in 2022. The number of building permits (gray line) experienced a significant increase, starting at 4,238 in 2012 and rising to a peak of 8,169 in 2022. The data is sourced from the National Statistical Institute (НСИ).
